The '''Iridium system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridium]],<ref name="SWE" /> home to the domesticated [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]].<ref name="TPG" />
